turns.text:
quick q can you make this msg to bao clearer and friendlier. iris already ordered the thursday sushi so i wanna finish this fast

"hey bao. recap from today's 3-5 training: trigger board swap = pop the back cover, unclip the ribbon, seat the new board, test the trigger before closing it up. u can do batteries and trigger boards now no prob, reimaging is next but not yet so dont touch those. if a scanner still wont boot after the board, put it in the cage and log it in the RMA sheet. dont skip the log. ty"

Here's a cleaner, friendlier version:

"Hey Bao! Quick recap from today's 3-5 training:

**Trigger board swap**
1. Pop off the back cover
2. Unclip the ribbon cable
3. Seat the new board
4. Test the trigger before closing it up

You've got batteries and trigger boards down now, nice work! Reimaging is the next step, but we haven't covered it yet, so leave those for now and send them my way.

If a scanner still won't boot after the board swap, put it in the cage and log it in the RMA sheet. Please don't skip the log, it saves us a lot of headaches later.

Thanks, and great job today!"

I kept all your steps in the same order. Want a shorter, more casual version too?
Glad it works! Enjoy the sushi.
